abstract: |
  This report presents the hydro-acoustic and trawl biosampling data collected by Fisheries and Ocean Canada (DFO) personnel during the Lake Enrichment and Study Lakes Program covering the period between 1977 to 2007. The data was rescued, cleaned and standardized by two interns hired by the Canadian Institute of Ecology and Evolution Living Data Project in partnership with the DFO personnel. In total, 177,541 records from 1977 to 1999 trawl biosampling original files were recovered, while 123,819 were recovered from the hydro-acoustic 1977-2007 original files.
